pages.text: Fight Terramity's structure bosses from Tier 1 on — this is a boss and combat content mod, and three of its bosses are on your Tier 1 boss-rush roster.$(br2)It also brings guns (craft them at the Gunsmith Station), armor sets with active abilities, and the structures that hold it all.

pages.title: The Boss Ladder
pages.text: $(t1)Tier 1$() — $(bold)Gob, King of Gnomes$() (Court of Gnomes — his summon is re-priced to emeralds so a T1 player can afford the fight), $(bold)Super Sniffer$() (Ancient Outcrop).$(br2)$(t3)Tier 3$() — $(bold)Gatmancer$() (Chthonic Dungeon, the Nether); $(bold)Enchanter Merlin$() and $(bold)Sorceress Circe$() (Occult Fabric on the Offering Pedestal in the Nether's Chthonic Cathedral, together); $(bold)Archmage Gundalf$() (appears when Circe falls).$(br)$(t4)Tier 4$() — $(bold)Thunker$() (Chthonic Cathedral), $(bold)Virtue$() (Prismatic Pond, the Aether).

pages.title: Virtue's Altar
pages.text: Virtue's altar is the $(bold)Prismatic Pond$(), a crystal pool on the Deep Aether islands of the Aether (the Boss Compass finds it).$(br2)Throw an $(bold)Unholy Lance$() (the Dead King's drop) into its prism solution: Virtue rises about ten seconds later. Thrown anywhere else, the lance calls nothing.

pages.title: Gear & Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Armor abilities$() live on the Numpad: $(k:terramity.armor_set_bonus_ability) set bonus, $(k:terramity.dash_ability) dash, $(k:terramity.slam) slam — see $(l:icraft:systems/keybinds)Keybinds$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)Void Mage and Exodium Warlock$() sets are robe-class mage armor under $(l:icraft:systems/armor_weight)Armor Weight$(/l).$(br2)Terramity structures also feed boss-material loot.$(br2)$(bold)Next: find the Court of Gnomes and summon Gob — the canonical first boss fight.$()
